rationale: Register the first usable core map and investigate one sourced identity-preservation discrepancy. No claim or check is fixed yet.

question.question: When a later contextual heartbeat confirms a prefix containing remote read requests with distinct contexts, does leader release preserve the origin and context of every removed request so the intended pending batch can consume its barrier?
question.importance: A lost or misidentified barrier response can cause otherwise eligible remote reads to time out; context misassociation could affect read completion attribution. No safety violation or permanent stall is presumed.
contexts: Stable leader term and unchanged membership
Two distinct remote contexts admitted before later-context quorum confirmation
event_paths: HeartbeatResp -> readIndex.confirm prefix release -> ReadIndexResp -> ReadyToRead -> pendingReadIndex.addReady

Contextual heartbeats only go to voters; unknown/old-term responses are filtered.
Confirmation intentionally raises earlier read indexes and may batch prefix completion; index equality alone is not an identity error.
